'''Teven Aerwin''' was an author.

==History==
Teven Aerwin was the author of ''[[The Dance of the Hawk and the Hummingbird]]'', a book purportedly laying out proper conduct between men and women. [[Liandrin]] burnt a copy of his book in [[Fal Dara]].{{ref/book|2|5}} 

It is possible, but unlikely, that the [[Feast of Teven]] has some connection with this author.
